scope.description: Implementation-owned automatic joint-exit continuation under an aborted transfer with stable leadership and viable joint quorum.
assumptions: Only network TimeoutNow loss is needed in the prefix; ordinary Raft messages continue to be delivered
Caller performs ordered persistence, committed configuration application and completion acknowledgments
The suffix contains regular ticks and drains all resulting work without unrelated new proposals
No crash, Byzantine input, invalid membership operation or skipped caller completion
excluded: No fixed numeric deadline or claim that finite waiting alone proves non-progress
No consensus-safety, client response-time or whole-cluster unavailability claim
No claim that later application work or a new election cannot recover

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: No protocol modifications or internal field writes.
MemoryStorage substitutes successful durable-write completion under a no-crash fault schedule.
Reflection reads private state only to compare two complete runtime states; excludes non-behavioral logger objects and storage access counters.
Drops exactly the first generated TimeoutNow in transfer branch; later messages are delivered.
Absolute test tick/event counters are omitted from recurrence state because the independently declared repeated input is ten tick-all/drain iterations; they do not feed Raft.

plan_uncertainties: One synchronous configuration and transfer schedule; asynchronous storage, crashes and other memberships are outside observation.
No client-response deadline, consensus safety violation or global service unavailability is asserted.
The source-based closure of the repeated input schedule is essential to interpreting recurrence; a finite equal business-state projection would be insufficient.
grounding_unresolved: Fixed recurrence observations and semantic correspondence have not yet been executed/reviewed.
Fresh execution must show recurrence and live pending state for attribution; reflection coverage and source-based recurrence reasoning need correspondence review.
